use_case_changes.setting_proposal: Published comparisons cover one diagnostic assay's positive agreement with initial blood culture (Karius 2019), an independent comparison of 14 classification configurations on six DNA mock-community datasets (Portik et al. 2022), four pipelines on five blood-culture-positive patient samples with negative controls (Song et al. 2025), and standard against pathogen-focused databases for M. tuberculosis read classification (Hall and Coin 2024). No source compares workflows on a large clinical cohort with a composite reference standard.
evidence_gaps_add: No independent comparison of CZ ID, SURPI, DRAGEN Microbial or BugSeq on clinical DNA specimens with printed per-tool values was found in this pass.

The multi-tool evidence is from mock communities (Portik et al. 2022) or constructed metagenomes (Hall and Coin 2024); the only patient-sample comparison (Song et al. 2025) has five culture-positive samples of one organism group and prints relative abundances, not detection calls.
Kraken and MetaPhlAn versions and databases are unreported in Song et al. 2025.
Per-pipeline culture concordance for 213 sterile body fluids (Lao et al. 2024, nanopore 16S) is printed only in prose and was not extracted.

Organisms absent from the reference are covered only indirectly: two species missing from several databases (Portik et al. 2022 Table 4 footnote) and database completeness for M. tuberculosis (Hall and Coin 2024). No clade-exclusion benchmark with a pathogen focus was extracted.
LEMMI, CAMI Benchmarking Portal and Govender and Eyre 2022 observed values (figures only) were not used.
use_case_changes.pinned_fields_note: No change is proposed to question, decision, inputs, output or exclusions. These fields are pinned by the existing Karius judgement (use-case-mapping-amp-20261007-issue13); changing them withholds it until re-review. The current decision and inputs name only plasma cfDNA and blood culture; if the integrator widens them to cover mock-community and read-classification evidence, re-pin the Karius judgement in the same reviewed change.

summary_proposal.source_locator: dna-pathogen-20261009-source-portik2022: Table 4; dna-pathogen-20261009-source-song2025: Table 2; dna-pathogen-20261009-source-hall2024: Tables 5-8
summary_proposal.text: In six mock-community datasets (Portik et al. 2022), Kraken2 and Bracken detected all or all but one of the scored species but also reported 44 to 204 species that were not in the community, so their precision was 0.05 to 0.21. On the four long-read datasets, MEGAN-LR (three variants) and BugSeq-V2 reported 0 to 2 absent species, with recall 0.70 to 1.00. In shotgun reads from five blood-culture-positive patients (Song et al. 2025), BLAST assigned viridans group streptococci in all five samples but also in the negative blood control (1.03E-1) and the no-template control (2.59E-1); Kraken assigned them in three samples, and RTG Core and MetaPhlAn in one, with none in the controls. For M. tuberculosis reads in sputum-like metagenomes (Hall and Coin 2024), kraken with its standard database classified 0.07 to 0.74 of the M. tuberculosis reads correctly, against 0.97 to 0.995 with a Mycobacterium database built by the authors; specificity was 1.0 for every kraken database. None of this is clinical validation: two sources use mock or constructed samples, the patient study has five samples of one organism group and reports abundances rather than detection calls, and databases differ between configurations.

gaps: Clinical cohorts with a reference standard and several workflows: none found with printed per-tool tables apart from Song et al. 2025 (n = 5).
Commercial or hosted clinical pipelines (CZ ID, SURPI+, DRAGEN Microbial, One Codex, Karius versus others) lack independent head-to-head tables in this pass.
Portik et al. 2022 genus-level and 0.1% and 1% threshold tables (Additional file 1 Tables S10-S16) not extracted.
Hall and Coin 2024 human read removal Tables 1-4 and coverage Tables S9-S12 not extracted.
Song et al. 2025 BLAST e-value optimisation results are figure-only (Figure 1).
Lao et al. 2024 16S sterile-fluid per-pipeline accuracy in prose only.
No result is comparable across sources: samples, databases and scoring rules differ.
concerns_for_reviewer: Song et al. 2025 Table 1 Kraken column prints 5.17E-10, 5.17E-10, 5.17E-11 and 5.17E-12 for four species; the repeated mantissa is unusual. Transcribed as printed; no evidence concern raised.

Song et al. 2025 Discussion and Conclusion describe BLAST as reaching complete concordance without false positives; this refers to the e-value-optimised run (Figure 1). Table 2, which was extracted, shows BLAST signal in both negative controls. Recorded in the protocol version and a claim, not as a conflict.

Song et al. 2025 cites Kraken as Wood and Salzberg 2014; whether Kraken 1 or Kraken 2 ran on Galaxy is not stated. The configuration links to a new Kraken (v1) method record on the strength of the citation.
Song et al. 2025 Results paragraph 1 says the standard contains yeasts; Table 1 lists eight bacteria only.
Portik et al. 2022 sourmash rows are recorded as author_reported because two co-authors are sourmash authors (references 33-35); the article's competing-interests statement does not say this.
Portik et al. 2022 Results says short-read methods detected 40-300 false positives; Table 4 ranges from 0 to 307 across short-read rows. Prose is a loose summary; table values recorded.

Hall and Coin 2024 states kraken v2.1.2 only for the library download used in simulation; classification configurations leave version unreported. minimap2 v2.26 is taken from the human read removal methods.
Portik Table 4 precision, recall, F1 and F0.5 were recomputed from the printed TP, FP and FN for all 70 rows: all 280 agree with the printed two-decimal values.
